headline: Chandra Kumar Dhanuka files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Chandra Kumar Dhanuka has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited with NSE. The filing signals a material equity move in the listed tea company, triggering mandatory takeover-code disclosures.
detail: Chandra Kumar Dhanuka has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, to NSE, indicating acquisition of shares in Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited. This disclosure is typically filed when a party acquires or proposes to acquire shares that meet or exceed the substantial acquisition threshold (25% or a controlling stake). The filing is a mandatory transparency requirement under the takeover code; further detail on quantum, acquisition route (open market, preferential, creeping, or block deal), and whether an open offer is triggered depends on the actual shareholding quantum and exemption status.
